name: Kettlebell Hand-to-Hand Swing
description: A one-arm swing where you release the bell at the top of the arc and catch it with the OTHER hand, then swing it down and back up to switch again — alternating hands every rep. The hip hinge drives the bell (arms are ropes); the hand switch happens at the weightless float point around chest height, not by muscling it across. The iconic kettlebell hand-eye-coordination drill — builds the hinge plus catch-timing and grip. Start light; the catch is the skill, not the load.
